Alex: Quick follow-up from the all-hands re: org changes. Opening this thread for any clarifications on headcount, transfers, and timelines.
Jordan: Happy to field questions.
Riley: For the runtime hires, are those backfills or net-new?
Jordan: Mostly net-new: target +6 net runtime ICs in H1. Expect 2 rotations from eng-platform for pairing/handoffs.
Priya: Recruiting posted 7 reqs this morning (3 infra, 2 runtime, 1 PM, 1 support). Greenhouse tags set to P0/P1.
Sam: If hiring slips, will feature roadmaps move?
Jordan: We'll shift non-critical features later and keep perf/cost work prioritized.
Leah: Funding check: plan approved for H1; no hiring freeze planned. We'll reevaluate at Q2 close if things change.
Riley: How will promotions/transfers be handled compensation-wise?
Priya: Standard calibration applies. For urgent role changes we have an accelerated adjustment process (2 pay cycles). Managers will get templates.
Alex: When will the new org chart be published?
Priya: Org chart + role matrix by Friday EOD.
DeployBot: publish-org-chart job succeeded (s3://company-assets/org-charts/2026-04-10.pdf) :white_check_mark:
Sam: Thanks everyone. If you don't hear from your manager about transitions, DM them and cc Jordan/People.
Alex: I'll summarize outstanding Qs tomorrow and close the thread unless new items come up. :pray:
